evidence: Source review against native build 1 for the offered-model check: no route, request or response shape changed. Ticket employee-configuration, which TicketAPI.setTicketWorkerConfiguration sends, can now return the existing 400 validation envelope for a model the Ticket's machine does not list. APIClient.validate decodes error.message and APIError shows it, as it already did for disabled models. Dispatch refusals reuse the existing model_resolution_failed reason, which ConversationDelivery.refusalText and TicketRecapDelivery.note already map. No native code changed. This is source review only; no signed-device, TestFlight, or native reconnect checks ran.
